note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own. Guides are written in our own words; each cites its sources. Hidden flags follow Exophase / PSNProfiles (28 hidden). Only one trophy is flagged as potentially missable by the guides.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no online or DLC requirement — everything is single-player, one playthrough is enough, and the long road is the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Budget around 200 hours in total, most of it after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1. Just play the story.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Keep playing the main missions.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. Nothing to do but follow the story.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops partway through Chapter 4, after the first two main missions of the chapter, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, the gold for finishing the game. It pops when you complete the final mission of the story (PowerPyx lists it after the Chapter 4 finale, Starting From Zero). There is no mission replay, so if you want a safety net, keep a manual save from the start of the final chapter.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run — just complete the mission.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than true 100% — roughly 60% of everything: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks, plus 70 of the 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts and 15 of 18 meditations. Nothing in it is missable; all of it can be finished in free-roam after the story.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them freely, and the under-the-bridge ones are the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so you will pass 250 on the way. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and find them on the map with the Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon). You will do one of each almost by accident while chasing the other trophies.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread over 12 range locations. The gold medals are not too hard, and every range is also needed for the 100% checklist, so work through them after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). All of them are required for the 100% checklist too.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations across Leonida, so pick the 20 that suit you — road races in a fast car are the simplest.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple icon) west of Key Lento — go there and beat him at fishing.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are four Video Games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one of them once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline — Lucia only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The whole line stays available after the story.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — follow the purple chest icons, use the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring each find back to him. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last one. Everything stays available after the story.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Careful: not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street racing and Pilot Pete's deliveries; more strangers are still being found. They all stay available in free-roam after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the Zorrusso is already done in the mission, leaving 15 to steal. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted, then drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Good condition pays more. Sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — Jason only. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City: go in and destroy them (Take Out Kitty Litter). Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This — shut the labs down for good and the trophy pops. All of it stays available after the story.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at the same spot counts double. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. WARNING — THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can only be done in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It adds +1 to your counter even though it is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required. The last meditation needs both characters together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: as Jason you get a text that starts Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it — Jason only). Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. There are 15 Target Decks to finish for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida — any 3 finished sets count, so take the ones nearest your route and leave the awkward ones.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK it at 100 locations. Hold up and R1 to scan the world around you: landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) all count, and there are more than 100 scannable spots in total, so take whichever 100 you pass.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — just do the easy ones first and leave the hardest 10 untouched. Track them under Progress > Challenges.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters together, so earliest is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with hold-right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing carnage, then escape in a fast sports bike; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy route, since police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. You will also get it automatically while robbing the large bank vaults for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (you need to switch characters and call your partner). Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while the red/blue flashing wanted level stays up — do not let it drop to the red heat level or clear entirely. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline) from Ammu-Nation. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a few items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold up to use it instantly) and scan vehicles with R1 — just stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. You only need to scan them, not drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this comes free on the way. Track them under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Aim a firearm and press L3 + R3: time slows and weak spots light up, draining the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and pop Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the slow-motion. Line up 5 criminals at a Gang Operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 — it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels and grows by doing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets much easier late in the game.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot a few enemies until it pops.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons) on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (never kick the door — that trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (it is marked automatically from story progress) — it teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and the vault to open, then go in fast and rob it. Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold right to hand off a bag. Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip for more security vans (finish his Payday Loan jobs first). There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so you will clear 5 on the way. Vaults pay up to $205,000 each.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that opens bank vault robberies — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts. Or do it early: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map, all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. You only need one operation per gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by the story. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. You need the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City — and only that car works, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack in, drive forward straight through the window, and the trophy pops a moment later once you are out on the street.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — by stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a Gang Operation in Port Gellhorn. It is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and blow the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. It is not missable: the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can come back for any valuables you missed.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Buy a fitness club membership, always train together — call your partner (hold right + Triangle) — because while one of you works out, the other finishes their training automatically, doubling progress. Find clubs on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your criminal profile. Turn on notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a little demon face appears whenever an action counts, and you can watch the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Profiles run from Professional (stealthy jobs, destroying evidence, clean getaways) through Hardened (incapacitating without killing) and Violent to Psycho, with Irredeemable as a permanent status if you go too far — avoid that one, since police get far more aggressive. It builds passively through robberies and fights, so most players get it without trying.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Currently unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy as unknown, with the leading theory that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way (Little Cuba, Vice City). Do not grind for it until a method is confirmed; check the cited guide for updates.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Walk up to it and it drops the woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside as she asks. The spawn is slightly random: if the blinking car is not there, drive away and come back.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, and a single bank vault pays up to $205,000, so it comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive, so they are the fastest way to burn through it. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend in.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to fund them.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need parking first, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
